document:0:231:0.text:
Keira, thirty days have passed since the war... and only a rushed funeral.

Will no miracle come? You fought for Halia... you were <style="highlight">blessed by the God of Harvest</style>!

Will He <style="highlight">save you again</style>? Like when you were lost in Dregwood, starving, and a <style="highlight">petal umbrella</style> appeared before you?

You told me you saw me and your mother in a dream, and when you woke, we were there.

Others call it a hallucination from the petal umbrella, but we know the truth. It was a miracle. The God of Harvest guided us to you!

And that <style="highlight">wild sandbeast led me there</style>, it was so strong... It surely was <style="highlight">the God's chosen beast</style>!

Keira, I believe you've returned to his embrace. I won't try to take you from His hands. I only pray for one thing...

<style="highlight">Let me see you once more... even if only in my dreams.</style>
document:0:231:0.source_cn:
奎莉，那场战争已经过去了三十天……只有一场朴素的葬礼。一切都那么草率。
奇迹真的不会发生了吗？明明你是为呼临城而战……你<style="highlight">受丰饶神的庇护</style>啊！
伟大的神，他会不会<style="highlight">再一次救你</style>？就像你误入水淀枯林时那样，在你饥肠辘辘时，将果腹的<style="highlight">弥纹花伞</style>送到你眼前？
你告诉我，你在幻梦中看见了我和你妈妈。当你醒来时，美梦成真，我们真的到了你眼前。
其他人都说，那是因为弥纹花伞致幻。可你我都知道，那是真正的神迹……是丰饶神指引我们找到你的！
<style="highlight">那只为我引路的野猪</style>，它那样强壮……必定是<style="highlight">丰饶神的眷属</style>！
奎莉，我想你已经回到了他的怀抱，我不会妄图从神手中抢走你。我只求神应允我唯一的祈愿：
<style="highlight">让我在梦里，再见你一面……</style>

say:2:1520638001:1.text: This wild boar is a familiar of the God of Harvest?

say:3:1520638002:0.text: That's right. In our records of the God of Harvest, <style="highlight">his mount is a mighty boar</style>.
say:3:1520638002:0.source_cn: 没错。在有关丰饶神的记载中，<style=highli...

say:4:1520638003:0.text: Legend has it that after the God of Harvest blessed us with the dew of the heavens and fertile soil, he had this boar carry seeds of grain in its mouth and sow them from the sky, bringing us food and prosperity.
say:4:1520638003:0.source_cn: 传说，丰饶神在赐予我们天上的甘露、地上的沃土后，就让这...

say:5:1520638004:0.text: Our faith is strong because he has always been merciful, always protecting us.
say:5:1520638004:0.source_cn: 正因他如此仁慈，始终庇护着我们，我们才这么信仰他。

say:7:1520638005:1.text: You and Gala exchange a look. Clearly, neither of you wants to bring up the fact that the God of Harvest has fallen from grace in front of a devout Halian.
say:7:1520638005:1.source_cn: 你和加拉对视了一眼。很显然，你们都不想在一个呼临人面前...

document:10:232:0.text:
As I suspected, Keira, that truly was a miracle from the God of Harvest! <style="highlight">This mushroom can actually be turned into sugar!</style>

Do you remember the candy Dad used to make for you? You loved it so much! You always said one piece could make you forget your worries.

Keira, candy isn't just about sweetness, it's about the true happiness it brings...

<style="highlight">Candy that can make someone happy even in their dreams—that's true sweetness!</style>

If they eat it, then the starving children, the orphans, they'll be happy. Enough to survive the famine until it ends...

God, You have shown mercy and compassion! Children, praise His name!

(The writing becomes increasingly distorted after this... you can't read it.)
document:10:232:0.source_cn:
果然，奎莉，那果然是丰饶神赐下的神迹！<style="highlight">这种蘑菇居然可以制糖</style>！
还记得爸爸给你做的糖吗？你最喜欢吃了！你总说糖果甜甜的，吃一颗就能忘记烦恼。
奎莉，糖果的妙处不仅在味道……还应该包括它带来的，真正的幸福……
<style="highlight">能让人在美梦中幸福的糖果，才是真正的甜蜜！</style>
只要吃下它，那些饥荒中挨饿的、失去亲人的、孤苦无依的孩子们，就会幸福，就能撑到饥荒结束那天了……
神啊，您还是降下了仁慈与怜悯！孩子们啊，称颂他的名吧！
（后面的字迹愈发扭曲，你已经无法辨认了……）

say:17:1520638011:1.text: Can I trust you to pass this information to Lieutenant Lygos for me?
say:17:1520638011:1.source_cn: 真的吗？你可以帮我把这件事转告隆尔副将吗？
say:17:1520638011:1.male: Can I trust you to pass this information to Lieutenant Lygos for me?
say:17:1520638011:1.female: Can I trust you to pass this information to Lieutenant Lygos for me?

say:19:1520638013:1.text: Alright... you're guests of the General, and you saved Matthew's life. I will trust you to do this for me, even if one of you is a Wildborn.
say:19:1520638013:1.source_cn: 好……你们是统帅的客人，又救了马修一命，我愿意相信你们...

say:20:1520638014:1.text: I'll write a report. Please <style="highlight">deliver it to Lieutenant Lygos</style> for me.
say:20:1520638014:1.source_cn: 我会写一封汇报信，麻烦你们帮我<style=highl...

say:22:1520638015:1.text: A short while later, Zell hands a folded letter to you.
say:22:1520638015:1.source_cn: 没过多久，泽尔就将一封折好的信交给了你和加拉。

say:24:1520638016:1.text: Make sure Lieutenant Lygos gets this letter. And you'll have my thanks.
say:24:1520638016:1.source_cn: 务必将这封信交给隆尔副将，多谢。
